定义：Planned obsolescence means designing a product so that it will soon become unfashionable or impossible to use and will need replacing.

哪项准确解释了这个术语？

back_content.text: 答案：A。Manufacturers intentionally design products to become outdated or unusable soon, prompting replacement.

front_content.text: 一项措施旨在让经济扩张的收益覆盖更广泛的社会群体。哪项英文改写最准确？

back_content.text: A。The policy aims to spread the benefits of growth to broader social groups.
back_content.explanation: aims to 保留措施的目的，broader social groups 保留覆盖人群扩大这一含义；不能把目的直接写成已经实现的效果。

options.text: The policy aims to spread the benefits of growth to broader social groups.
